style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted fantasy deckbuilder; adventurous with a light touch of humor. This art belongs to the SHARED WORLD that every playable hero visits, so it must never show or hint at any particular hero: no dragon scales, claws, tails, wings, horns or dragon fire, and no people. The world is an original realm of enchanted forest ruins overrun by ancient clockwork golems: weathered pale stone and colored sandstone, tarnished bronze and brass, gears and rivets, moss, ivy and small ferns, oak, leather, old parchment and ivory, and softly glowing teal rune light (abstract glowing lines, never letters). Palette: blackened iron #2A2426, weathered stone, tarnished bronze #8A6A3A, ivory #EFE2C4, amber gold #F2A93B, mossy greens and teal rune light #3FC9B5, with crimson, plum-purple or sky-blue accents only where the subject calls for them. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm highlights; reserve soft emission for runes, magic and VFX. Do not imitate any existing game, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements. Square event illustration like a storybook vignette, one clear focal subject, soft dark vignette at the edges. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI.

assets.prompt: A cracked mossy stone fountain in forest ruins sputtering glowing teal rune water and small sparks, something gold glinting at the bottom of its basin.
A pile of gold coins and goblets in a dark forest hollow still glowing ember-orange from an old forgotten fire, drifting embers and soft smoke.

A friendly old merchant golem of weathered sandstone and bronze with a coin slot in its chest and little shelves of potions and trinkets built into its body, standing in forest ruins, one teal rune eye.
A large heap of warm grey ash glittering with gold coins inside ruined stone walls, a mysterious amber glow deep inside it, thin wisps of smoke.
A patched-up practice golem of oak and bronze raising two wooden-sword arms in a ready stance, in a mossy clearing with straw targets.
A steaming hot spring between mossy stones under ancient trees, an old whetstone bench beside it, soft golden light through the leaves.
A dapper slender bronze golem barber with shear-blade hands and a curled mustache-shaped plate, beside a carved stone barber chair in forest ruins.
A bronze alchemist's crucible on a rune-carved stone stand, teal brew swirling inside on its own, glass vials and rolled blank scrolls around it.
A round stout golem whose belly is a colorful prize wheel with simple pictograms of a coin, a heart and a gem and a bronze crank handle, beckoning, in forest ruins.
A mossy stone altar holding a humming rune stone that glows crimson and teal, carved channels in the altar and a small offering bowl of coins.
